[arxiv:2402.04249] To meet this crucial need, we propose \emph{SALAD-Bench}, a safety benchmark specifically designed for evaluating LLMs, attack, and defense methods. [arxiv:2402.05044] Evaluating these attacks presents a number of challenges, which the current collection of benchmarks and evaluation techniques do not adequately address. [arxiv:2404.01318] We introduce Synthetic Alignment data Generation for Safety Evaluation and Red Teaming (SAGE-RT or SAGE) a novel pipeline for generating synthetic alignment and red-teaming data. [arxiv:2408.11851] While existing benchmarks demonstrate the near-perfect performance of large language models (LLMs) on various tasks, this apparent saturation often obscures the need for rigorous evaluation of their reliability. [arxiv:2605.11209] While effective, manual red-teaming is costly, and existing automatic red-teaming typically discovers safety risks without addressing them. [arxiv:2311.07689]
